name: Wikipedia manual recovery
description: Search for Ada Lovelace, correct a failed section check, then read and close the article.
intro: Welcome. We will find an article on Wikipedia, then complete one browser step by hand.

steps.title: Type Ada Lovelace in Wikipedia
steps.say: I move to Wikipedia's search field and type Ada Lovelace. The matching article appears below the field.

steps.title: Click the Ada Lovelace result
steps.say: I click the result in the search suggestions and check the article heading.

steps.title: Open Biography
steps.say: I open Biography from the article's contents and leave that section selected.

steps.title: Check for the Work section
steps.say: The check expects Work. When it fails, I click Work in Wikipedia's contents myself, verify the heading, then choose Confirm.

steps.title: Read the recovered section
steps.say: I verify that Work is open and scroll down through the section.

steps.title: Close the walkthrough window
steps.say: I close the rehearsal window after reading the recovered section.
